newsitem.title: UK: LME copper stays just above $2,200 late.
newsitem.headline: LME copper stays just above $2,200 late.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) three months delivery copper eased slightly but stayed just around the $2,200 per tonne mark in quiet inter-office activity, holding most gains that had been made by the afternoon kerb close. By 1900 GMT when Comex ended LME copper was bid at $2,203 compared with a kerb close at $2,208 which was up $25 from Tuesday. Spread backwardations held steady through Wednesday with cash/threes ending at $170.

Traders said the late gains had reflected the routine Dec option expiry earlier. This removed some of the volatility and uncertainty from the market as the large open interest calls remained out-of-the-money and thus passed out of the picture.
Stock movements and "third Wednesday" tightness will dictate short-term direction now, traders added.
Aluminium was bid late at $1,535 after final kerb business at $1,537, up $10 from Tuesday.
